result.instructions: Tools for Docketwise, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the matters of my firm and show their status."; "Show the receipts of the matter for John Doe."; "Which invoices are unpaid?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Docketwise data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run docketwise_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run docketwise_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run docketwise_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. docketwise_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: docketwise_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: The firm's contacts (clients, leads and institutions), 200 per page: id, name, company, email, lead flag, physical address. Filter by type. Use docketwise_get_contact for one contact with its notes.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). A page holds up to 200 records; see `pagination` in the reply for the next page.

limit.description: Records to show from the page, 1-200 (default 100). Records beyond it on the same page are counted in `omitted`.

tools.name: docketwise_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: One contact by id, with its address and notes.

id.description: The contact id (an integer, from docketwise_list_contacts).

tools.name: docketwise_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new contact (person or institution) in the firm's Docketwise. Optionally with one address and one daytime phone. Creates a record; it does not check for duplicates.

lead.description: true = a lead, not yet a client.

tools.name: docketwise_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: WRITE: changes the basic fields of one contact (name, company, email, lead flag). Only the fields you give are sent; each replaces the stored value. Addresses and phones are not changed here.

id.description: The contact id (an integer, from docketwise_list_contacts).

tools.name: docketwise_create_matter
tools.title: Create a matter
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new matter (case) for an existing client contact in the firm's Docketwise. The client_id is required; user_ids are the firm users assigned (docketwise_list_users).

client_id.description: The client contact id (an integer, from docketwise_list_contacts).

user_ids.description: Firm users assigned to the matter.

items.description: The user id (an integer, from docketwise_list_users).

tools.name: docketwise_create_note
tools.title: Create a note
tools.description: WRITE: adds a note to a matter or to a client contact (give matter_id or client_id) in the firm's Docketwise.

matter_id.description: The matter id (an integer, from docketwise_list_matters).

client_id.description: The client contact id (an integer, from docketwise_list_contacts).

tools.name: docketwise_update_note
tools.title: Update a note
tools.description: WRITE: replaces the title and/or text of an existing note. The previous text is not kept by this server. Docketwise requires matter_id or client_id again (the matter or client the note belongs to).

id.description: The note id (an integer, from the notes of docketwise_get_matter or docketwise_get_contact).

matter_id.description: The matter id (an integer, from docketwise_list_matters).

client_id.description: The client contact id (an integer, from docketwise_list_contacts).
